# Community health worker caseload

The clinic has two community health workers whose job description includes home visits to patients who missed a follow-up, among a long list of other duties: vaccination campaigns, maternal health checks, and increasingly, paperwork for a reporting system that was added last year without removing anything from what came before it.

When asked to estimate their own time, both health workers gave numbers that add up to well over what a normal working week holds, and the missed-follow-up home visits were, by their own account, the task most likely to get pushed to next week when something more urgent came up, which is most weeks. Neither worker frames this as a complaint exactly; they frame it as a sequencing problem, since nothing on their list is actually optional, and the follow-up visits are the only item without an externally imposed deadline attached to it, which quietly makes them the easiest thing to defer, week after week, without anyone deciding that on purpose.
